sentences.text:
Mr  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 05.01.2026 CRL.M.A. 21761/2025 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
CRL.M.A. 21760/2025 (for interim protection)
2. The accused/applicant seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No.60/2024 of PS Cyber Police, Dwarka for offence under Section 420/120B/34 IPC.
3. Learned counsel for accused/applicant seeks and is allowed opportunity to examine and address the legality of WhatsApp group of money investments.
According to the FIR, it is not a case of simple investment advice having gone wrong.
It appears to be a larger group.
Further, learned counsel for accused/applicant also is granted time to examine and address as regards the legality of demand of tax by the WhatsApp group floated by the accused/applicant.
4. Learned APP seeks and is allowed to file fresh status report, disclosing if there are more victims of the alleged fraud.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 05/01/2026 at 20:32:42 5.
Despite specific directions of the predecessor bench, the accused/applicant has not personally appeared.
As such, there is no continuance of the interim protection.
6. Relist on 04.02.2026 in Advance List.
GIRISH KATHPALIA, J JANUARY 5, 2026/as
This is a digitally signed order.
